build_code_similarity_index: build a code similarity index from all transformers modeling files using embedding and Jaccard metrics
analyze_modeling_file: analyze a modeling file and find similar code definitions in the transformers codebase
push_code_index_to_hub: push the built code similarity index to a Hugging Face Hub dataset repository
summarize_code_similarities: summarize code similarity results between a new model file and existing transformers models
review_model_modularization: review a modeling file to determine which existing classes can be modularized as candidates
